plan.title: Draft line item rejects letter quantity

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects required by the saved draft.
Open the first existing saved draft from the Drafts tab.
Open the draft's Manage Line Items window.
Confirm the line-item management window opened.

args.goal: select a product from the product dropdown in the Manage Line Items window

steps.note: Select the product requested by the case without inventing a product name.
Enter the requested price before attempting to save.
Assert that saving is refused or remains disabled because Quantity contains letters.
